target.title: fix(feishu): preserve text when replies include media
target.body:
Closes #102390

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Feishu users would lose the visible text from an assistant final reply when that reply also included a regular `MEDIA:` attachment while streaming cards were active. The channel could finish with only the no-visible-content fallback instead of showing the assistant's text alongside the attachment.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Feishu streaming reply path now closes the active final streaming card before dispatching regular media attachments, and it falls back to a normal text send first if the streaming close reports that no text became visible. That keeps the final text visible while preserving the existing separate media send behavior and the voice-media text suppression path.

AI-assisted.

## User Impact

Feishu replies that combine text with an image or other regular attachment now keep the assistant's text visible and still send the attachment. Users should no longer see the misleading "reply completed without visible content" fallback for this text-plus-media streaming reply shape.

## Evidence

Source-level before/premise: on current main, the active streaming branch updated the final text and then returned after media dispatch without closing the streaming card in that branch. Feishu media sending does not carry a caption parameter, so the text needs to be made visible through the streaming card path, or sent as plain text when the card close reports that no text became visible.

After fix:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.test.ts` -> 88 tests passed, including final text plus regular media and close-false fallback coverage.
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.extensions.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/extensions-test.tsbuildinfo` -> passed.
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.ts extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.test.ts` -> passed.
- `git diff --check` -> passed.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local` -> clean, no accepted/actionable findings after the close-false repair.

I did not run a live Feishu client smoke in this checkout. The focused regression tests exercise the dispatcher path directly: final text plus regular media closes the streaming card before media, and if close reports no visible content the dispatcher sends the final text as a normal message before sending the attachment, without sending the no-visible-reply fallback.
